Andrea / Sam —

Quick technical note ahead of the kickoff: for the initial sandbox we recommend the following minimums to exercise runtime features (latency/caching paths):
- 1 x 16 vCPU, 64GB RAM, 1 x A10G-equivalent GPU for load tests (if you plan > 50 concurrent sessions use 2 x GPUs)
- Alternatively, CPU-only VM for dev iteration: 8 vCPU / 32GB RAM (will be slower and no GPU-accelerated kernels)

Networking / certs: we need a temporary allowlist of Redwood egress IPs and an SSH public key for the VM (if you want us to bring a prebuilt image). Marcus will own the cert exchange.
